sum: Gamehaus Holdings Inc., a technology-driven mobile game publishing company, distributes mobile games created by its developer partners across gaming markets in the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, Germany, France, Canada, Brazil, Japan, India and internationally. The company engages in the sale of virtual items associated with mobile games, as well as advertisements within its mobile games. It also provides support services, including game content development, screening and pre-publication testing, user acquisition, and monetization strategies services. Gamehaus Holdings Inc. is based in Shanghai, China.
